patreon.title: Git status: Read the Situation Before Committing
patreon.post:
Imagine you have prepared a bug fix, edited a note, and created a sketch. These changes need different decisions. Git status reports what is staged for the next commit, what has changed since staging, and what is untracked. A file can even have both a staged version and later unstaged edits.

Takeaway: read the report before committing. Status does not select or stage content for you.

What do you usually discover when you check status?

Source: https://git-scm.com/docs/git-status
